title: Activation- and Influence-Aware Ranks (AIR): Function-Preserving SVD Compression for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2606.19993v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present Activation- and Influence-Aware Ranks (AIR), an SVD-based LLM compression framework that guides each weight matrix's low-rank approximation with a backward-signal influence metric. Starting from the activation-aware optimum of SVD-LLM(W), AIR runs a single closed-form alternating least squares (ALS) sweep that integrates influence element-wise under a monotone-descent guarantee. AIR is layer-local and composes orthogonally with end-to-end methods: alone it exceeds ACIP, and AIR+LoRA outperforms it further. AIR improves perplexity over SVD-LLM(W) by >18% at <=60% parameter retention, matches its quality with ~90% less calibration data, and turns parameter savings into FLOP, peak-memory, and per-token latency gains.

translated_title: 激活与影响感知秩（AIR）：面向大语言模型的保功能SVD压缩
translated_abstract: 我们提出了激活与影响感知秩（AIR），这是一个基于SVD的大语言模型压缩框架，它利用一种基于反向信号的影响度量来指导每个权重矩阵的低秩近似。从SVD-LLM(W)的激活感知最优解出发，AIR仅需运行一次闭式交替最小二乘（ALS）扫描，即可在单调下降保证下逐元素地整合影响信息。AIR是层局部的，并可与端到端方法正交组合：单独使用时它超越ACIP，而AIR+LoRA则能进一步提升性能。AIR在参数保留率≤60%时将困惑度相比SVD-LLM(W)改善超过18%，并用约少90%的校准数据达到同等质量，同时将参数节省转化为FLOP、峰值内存和每token延迟方面的实际收益。
tldr: AIR是一种基于SVD的大语言模型压缩框架，通过将激活感知最优解与反向信号影响度量结合于单次闭式ALS扫描中，在参数保留率≤60%时实现超过18%的困惑度改善，校准数据需求减少约90%，并带来实际的计算量、内存和延迟收益。
en_tdlr: AIR is an SVD-based LLM compression framework that integrates activation-aware optimization with a backward-signal influence metric in a single closed-form ALS sweep, achieving over 18% perplexity improvement at ≤60% parameter retention, with ~90% less calibration data and real gains in FLOPs, memory, and per-token latency.
